hooks.description: Block edits to existing migration files — create a new one instead
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -q database/migrations/', {stdio:'pipe'}); console.error('BLOCKED: Never edit existing migration files. Create a new numbered migration file instead.'); process.exit(1); } catch(e) { process.exit(0); }"

hooks.description: Block edits to .env files — only .env.example is allowed
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -qE \"\\.env$\"', {stdio:'pipe'}); console.error('BLOCKED: Never write to .env files. Edit .env.example instead and let the developer fill in real values.'); process.exit(1); } catch(e) { process.exit(0); }"

hooks.description: Block edits to binary model weight files
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -qE \"\\.dat$|\\.h5$|\\.pb$|\\.tflite$\"', {stdio:'pipe'}); console.error('BLOCKED: Never edit binary model weight files (.dat, .h5, .pb, .tflite). These are trained model artifacts.'); process.exit(1); } catch(e) { process.exit(0); }"

hooks.description: Block rewrites of the existing face recognition script — wrap it in Flask, do not rewrite
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -q smart_attendance_system/gemattendance', {stdio:'pipe'}); console.error('BLOCKED: Do not rewrite gemattendance.py. This is the existing working script. Wrap it in Flask via app.py instead.'); process.exit(1); } catch(e) { process.exit(0); }"

hooks.description: Auto-fix ESLint errors in frontend JS/JSX files after every edit
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -q frontend/', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -qE \"\\.jsx?$|\\.tsx?$\"', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('cd frontend && npx eslint --fix ' + f.replace('frontend/',''), {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e) {}"

hooks.description: Auto-format frontend files with Prettier after every edit
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -q frontend/', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -qE \"\\.jsx?$|\\.tsx?$|\\.css$\"', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('cd frontend && npx prettier --write ' + f.replace('frontend/',''), {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e) {}"

hooks.description: Auto-fix ESLint errors in backend JS files after every edit
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -q backend/', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -qE \"\\.jsx?$|\\.tsx?$\"', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('cd backend && npx eslint --fix ' + f.replace('backend/',''), {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e) {}"

hooks.description: Auto-format Python files with Black after every edit
hooks.command: node -e "const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE||''; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); try { execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -q ai-service/', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('echo ' + f + ' | grep -qE \"\\.py$\"', {stdio:'pipe'}); execSync('python -m black ' + f, {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e) {}"
